scripts.test: npm --prefix ui test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:native && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write "ui/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" ui/vite.config.ts ui/tsconfig.json "scripts/*.mjs" package.json ui/package.json && ruff format backend tests && xcrun swift-format format --in-place native/*.swift
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "ui/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,css}" ui/vite.config.ts ui/tsconfig.json "scripts/*.mjs" package.json ui/package.json && ruff format --check backend tests && xcrun swift-format lint --strict native/*.swift
